faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Coordinator-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Coordinator-II recruitment is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Coordinator-II post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Project Coordinator-II post is M. Pharm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Coordinator-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Coordinator-II position is 30 years, as of 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Coordinator-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Coordinator-II post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Project Coordinator-II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Coordinator-II post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Coordinator-II post will be based on an Interview.
